description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” that shows the distribution of stimulus categories used in the study, with 10 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages around the ring: Draft/Other (26.4%) shown in a dark reddish-brown segment; Press Release (18.7%) in an olive/gold segment; External News Article (18.1%) in a dark green segment; Interview (8.8%) in a dark bluish-gray segment; Organizational Report (7.7%) in a muted purple segment; Event Posting (6.6%) in a brown segment; Organizational Website (4.9%) in a light purple/gray segment; Intra-agency news article (4.9%) in a blue segment; Email (2.7%) in a small greenish-gray segment; and Social Media Post (1.1%) in a very thin light tan segment. The chart uses direct text labels with percentages (not a separate legend), and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering rule.
